notes: Richmond grid (Fourteenth to Twenty-second Aves, Cabrillo to Clement): 4 columns x 9 rows of plain rectangular blocks, box sides in street paper (the bottom row's south lines at y about 1795, just inside the box). HOW DRAWN: one seed per block; strokes close two outline gaps: west side of block 1625 (thin, broken line x about 352, y 1133-1220) and the south side of block 1626 (gap at x 470-476, y 1334). Street names CABRILLO (x 350-370) and BALBOA (x 600-620) run from inside blocks 1624/1563 across the street (y 1108-1137); strokes placed 1-2 px into the street below the block's south line ((348,1110)-(374,1110), (597,1109)-(625,1109)) and above block 1625's north line ((348,1131)-(374,1131)) cut the letters' street part off, so it is street; a few px of street there are barrier. FOR THE OWNER TO RULE ON: (1) Thomas (an alley drawn as two lines, x about 1262-1278, y 1615-1682) opens onto the street through the south side of block 1447; read as street (a road drawn as two lines), so a narrow notch of street runs into the block. (2) The GEARY name box at the west end of block 1452 (x 1120-1150, y 1020-1105) lies inside the block outline and is labelled block. Unseeded islands left as street are dimension marks only (under 10 px).
